name: OHM
recent: OHM 近期的主要动态集中在董事与主要股东的股权变动上，包括 DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG 和 DATIN TANG JING WEN 在公开市场及闭市期间的交易。公司也发布了 2026 年报，并将在 2026 年 11 月 25 日召开第三届年度股东大会。此外，公司有一项未指明具体内容的「OTHERS」公告。
notable: DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG 在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次增持公司股份。
DATIN TANG JING WEN 在 2026 年 10 月 6 日及 11 月 3 日增持公司股份。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 25 日召开第三届年度股东大会。
risks: 董事 DATIN TANG JING WEN 及 DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG 在闭市期间表示有意进行证券交易。
公司有一项未说明具体内容的「OTHERS」公告。

recent_en: OHM's recent developments mainly involve changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including dealings by DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG and DATIN TANG JING WEN in the open market and during the closed period. In addition, there was an 'OTHERS' announcement with unspecified details.
notable_en: DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG acquired additional shares in the company multiple times between September and October 2026.
DATIN TANG JING WEN acquired additional shares on 6 October 2026 and 3 November 2026.
risks_en: Directors DATIN TANG JING WEN and DATUK TEOH YEE SEANG indicated their intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
The company had an 'OTHERS' announcement with unspecified details.
